notes.title: A lot of Mess for everyone! 64 and 32!
notes.notes:
some changes were made to the platform stage of subtitles and some textures. A metallic effect here and there ... to become more cute!
Another good news: now, it seems, who have machine operating system in 32 bit can mess up this mess too!
I hope you enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: THE BIG SPACE MESS - Update!
notes.notes:
This latest update has the full screen option and pause button.
If you lost points by killing the little angels, now has a sign indicating when they will appear.
I hope you enjoy!
